neighbours.label: The verb 'help' (also open, enable) right after 'you' in a statement of what the reader's action does
fire: By recycling cans, you help reduce the waste that fills landfills.
When you adopt a shelter dog, you help free a space for another.
If you donate blood, you help patients who need surgery.
With each purchase you are helping fund a school meal program.
By sharing your story, you open the door for others to speak.
When you vote, you help decide who runs the town.
Planting a tree, you help cool the street for years.
Careful notes can enable you to track progress each week.
quiet: By recycling cans, the town reduces the waste that fills landfills.
When you adopt a shelter dog, you pay a small fee at the desk.
If you donate blood, you fill out a short form first.
With each purchase you are given a receipt and a bag.
By sharing your story, you take a seat beside the others.
When you vote, you sign your name in the book.
Planting a tree, you dig a hole three feet deep.
Careful notes can sit beside you on the table each week.
